title: Restaurar o relocalizar la ruta publicada autoritativa de Live
mission: Determine the existing authoritative owner/path for Prometeo Live, restore or explicitly relocate that publication without inventing a parallel Live architecture, and leave a browser-verifiable served route for the blocked PIN-lineage verification.
definition_of_done: Identify the existing authoritative Live publication owner/path from CURRENT repository evidence.
Restore that route or update the existing authoritative route reference without creating a parallel Live architecture.
Verify the resulting public Live route returns a browser-verifiable document instead of HTTP 404.
Record any remaining stale capsule references separately; do not claim PIN-lineage/UI PASS unless rerun evidence proves it.

acceptance: authoritative live route returns a browser-verifiable document instead of http 404
existing live publication owner/path is restored or explicitly relocated without parallel architecture
